messages.subject: Boost RNGs
parts:
The Boost RNGs are all concept-based, right? In other words, no base
RNG class I can pass along instead of templating the RNG out as we
currently do? I’m just trying to see where we can limit templates and
the RNGs aren’t called enough to _really_ need to avoid any virtual
overhead.
